description: The collection contains GeoJSON points and infrastructure features for health, education, mobility, emergency services, waste and leisure. It includes roads, cycleways, railways, charging locations and passenger terminals alongside activity locations. ILU metadata records use of these traffic-generation poles in multimodality and context-sensitive transport analyses. Infrastructure status distinguishes executed features from planned or unfinished work; all listed facilities are not assumed operational. The catalogue gives 2019 while native metadata lists 2016/2019, leaving component-specific dates uncertain. Descriptive contact fields and media were not inspected. Coverage is limited to the source-described systems and experiments. The related Zenodo deposit provides descriptive metadata, with open document or data access and licence label cc-zero. Document rights do not establish software rights or access to the underlying observations. Only full descriptive metadata, file inventories and the project metadata catalogue were reviewed; no underlying measurements, code, paper or model archive was opened.
